# pixel-diet

Shrink images before a vision model pays for them, and compare images as numbers instead of pixels.

## Links

- Repository: https://github.com/slowpoke-flex/pixel-diet
- Skill: ./SKILL.md
- Quickstart: ./README.md
- Chinese: ./README.zh-CN.md
- Russian: ./README.ru.md
- Topics: ./docs/github-topics.md
- Launch: ./LAUNCH.md

## Use

Shrink an input with a named preset (no threshold tuning):

```bash
pixel-diet shrink shot.png -o slim.webp --preset ui-agent
pixel-diet shrink ./inbox -o ./clean --preset ocr-document --json report.json
cat shot.png | pixel-diet shrink - -o - --preset ui-agent > slim.webp
```

In code: `optimize_for_llm(path, preset="ui-agent")` returns a `data:` URI;
`optimize_bytes(raw, preset="ocr-document")` does bytes in, bytes out, no disk.

Compare outputs without opening pictures:

```bash
pixel-diet diff A.png B.png --brief --json report.json --sheet sheet.png
```

## Reporting rule

State the preset, the before/after pixels, the real byte sizes and the estimated image tokens
(`ceil(w*h/750)`, Anthropic's formula). Never quote a token saving without the formula. Never claim the
model output is identical; say what was tested and on which slice.
